G1536 (Hasbro) |Classification=Blade |Type=Attack |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=36.5 grams |System=Unique Line |Series=Beyblade X |ReleaseJP=March 30th, 2024 |ReleaseUS=October 2024 |ReleaseCA=January 6th, 2025 |AttackStat=70 |DefenseStat=20 |StaminaStat=10 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''DranBuster'''|ドランバスター|DoranBasutā}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Unique Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the UX-01 Starter, [[DranBuster 1-60A]], on March 30th, 2024. It later debuted in western countries as '''Buster Dran''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Buster Dran 1-60A]]. ==Description== '''DranBuster''' is an Attack Type Blade with an overall blocky shape. The Gear Chip features [[wikipedia:Azure Dragon|Seiryū]] [[wikipedia:Dragon Fire|shooting a fireball]]. As part of the ''[[Unique Line]]'', '''DranBuster''' has resin Launcher Hooks instead of metal ones, which increase Outward Weight Distribution (OWD). In addition, it features an Unique Line gimmick: a "large broadsword" tip-like protrusion on the bottom of '''DranBuster''' acts as the primary contact point and namesake. This creates an imbalanced weight distribution, with the weight being concentrated at the protrusion. This results in the ability for '''DranBuster''' to perform a {{Translation|"''[[wiktionary:one-hit kill|One Hit Kill]]''"|一撃必殺|Ichigeki Hissatsu}}, delivering a powerful blow with the protrusion. As a result of its shape, '''DranBuster''' has high Burst Attack and Knockout (KO) Attack. '''DranBuster''' is intended to be used in tandem with the [[Ratchet - 1-60|1-60]] Ratchet and [[Bit - Accel|Accel]] Bit. The 1-60 Ratchet has an imbalanced design that matches the weight distribution of '''DranBuster'''. The Accel Bit increases the speed of an [[Xtreme Dash]], causing heavier hits. Only one side of the sword tip protrusion makes contact with the opponent's Bey; consequently, this contact area will dent and chip over time. It is thus recommended to have several copies of '''DranBuster''' for competitive usage. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== *BX-48 [[Random Booster Vol. 9]] - 05: [[DranBuster 2-80Q]] (Metal Coat: Red Minor Change Version) *CX-08 [[Random Booster Vol. 7]] - 04: [[DranBuster 5-80MN]] *UX-01 [[DranBuster 1-60A]] *UX-04 [[Battle Entry Set U]] - [[DranBuster 1-60A]] (Special Ver.) *UX-00 [[DranBuster 1-60A]] (Metal Coat: Red) *UX-00 [[Dran Deck Starter]] - [[DranBuster 3-70N]] (Metal Coat: White) *UX-00 [[DranBuster 1-60A]] (Metal Coat: Blue FC Barcelona Ver.) *UX-00 [[DranBuster 1-60A]] (Metal Coat: Black) *UX-00 [[DranBuster 1-60A]] (Metal Coat: Cyan) *UX-00 [[DranBuster 1-60A]] (Metal Coat: Violet) ===Hasbro=== *G1536 [[Buster Dran 1-60A]] *G1751 [[Buster Dran 5-70DB]] *G3611 [[Buster Dran 5-70DB]] ==Gallery== BladeDranBuster.png|DranBuster (UX-01/G1536) DranBuster 1-60A (Special Ver.).jpg|DranBuster (Special Ver.) G2742 (Hasbro) |Classification=Blade |Type=Attack |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=41.4 grams |System=Basic Line |System2=Expand Blade |Series=Beyblade X (Season 3) |ReleaseJP=May 16th, 2026 |ReleaseUS=July 15th, 2026 |AttackStat=58 |DefenseStat=25 |StaminaStat=17 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''DranStrike'''|ドランストライク|DoranSutoraiku}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Basic Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-49 Starter, [[DranStrike 4-50FF]], on May 16th, 2026. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Infinity Starter Pack, [[Strike Dran 4-50FF]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Its six heavyweight blades are made more stable by the metal extending into the center, allowing for strong barrage attacks. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Strike Dran''' (Japanese: '''DranStrike''') is an Attack Type Blade with a six-sided design. The contact points are composed of 2 sets of 3 "wings", with the smaller wings protruding from the gaps between the larger wings. The design is similar to that of its predecessor, [[Blade - DranDagger|DranDagger (Dagger Dran)]], albeit with a more pronounced difference in wing lengths. The Gear Chip features [[wikipedia:Azure Dragon|Seiryū]] [[wikipedia:Dragon Fire|exhaling fire]]. [[Basic Line]] (BX) Blades have metal Launcher Hooks, which increases weight towards the center of the Blade. As part of the ''[[Expand Blade]]'' (''Infinity'') lineup, the Expanded feature of '''DranStrike''' is the extension of the metal beyond the Launcher Hooks, with the perimeter of the Gear Chip being made of metal. In the case of '''DranStrike''', the design intention is to increase [[Smash Attack]] capabilities. At the time of its release, '''DranStrike''' was the heaviest [[Basic Line]] (BX) Blade, at an average weight of 41.4 grams. It was also the heaviest non-[[Custom Line]] (CX) Blade, with the heaviest CX Blade combinations weighing about 5 grams more. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== *BX-49 [[DranStrike 4-50FF]] ===Hasbro=== *G2742 [[Strike Dran 4-50FF]] ==Gallery== BladeDranStrike.png|DranStrike (BX-49/G2742) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Basic Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-01 Starter, [[DranSword 3-60F]], on June 10th, 2023. It later debuted in western countries as '''Sword Dran''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Sword Dran 3-60F]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Using 3 upper blades, it launches its opponent upward diagonally. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Sword Dran''' (Japanese: '''DranSword''') is a three-sided Attack Type Blade with three upward slanting blades acting as the main contact points. The Gear Chip features [[wikipedia:Azure Dragon|Seiryū]] [[wikipedia:Dragon Fire|exhaling fire]]. '''DranSword''' was one of the first four Blades released, and was the first Attack Type Blade released. It was popular in [[3on3 Battle]] decks and remained heavily used from its release in June 2023 until January 2024, when it was gradually replaced by the heavier [[Blade - PhoenixWing|PhoenixWing (Soar Phoenix)]] Blade. During those 6 months, it also competed with the [[Blade - SharkEdge|SharkEdge (Keel Shark)]] Blade, which offered superior Attack potential, but less Stamina. '''DranSword''' also suffered from a wear issue, as the three upper blades would gradually wear down and become more blunt, reducing its [[Smash Attack]]. In addition, the metal components were known to shatter in some cases. Releases of '''DranSword''' produced during January 2024 onward (including all Hasbro releases of '''Sword Dran''') have a new reinforced mold that weighs over 35 grams. This second mold was first released with the ''Sushiro Version'' release, and is superior in performance, with less breakage issues. However, it retains the aforementioned wear issue, as the three upper blades remain unchanged. ==Overall== Although a strong release at the beginning of the toyline, '''DranSword''' has subsequently been replaced by heavier Attack Type Blades. F9584 (Hasbro) |Classification=Blade |Type=Balance |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=27.7 grams |System=Basic Line |System2=X-Over Project |Series=Beyblade X |ReleaseJP=July 15th, 2023 |ReleaseUS=June 1st, 2024 |ReleaseCA=May 30th, 2024 |ReleaseAU=May 16th, 2024 |AttackStat=35 |DefenseStat=30 |StaminaStat=35 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''DranzerSpiral'''|ドランザースパイラル|DoranzāSupairaru}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Basic Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-00 Booster, [[DranzerSpiral 3-80T]], on July 15th, 2023. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Dranzer Spiral 3-80T]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Designed with a focus on Balance, it features two horizontal blades that produce high striking power and Stamina. |speaker = Official Description}} '''DranzerSpiral''' is Balance Type Blade and [[X-Over Project]] adaptation of the [[Bit Chip - Dranzer|Dranzer]] Bit Chip, [[Attack Ring - Double Wing|Double Wing]] Attack Ring, and [[Weight Disk - Eight Balance|Eight Balance]] Weight Disk that came with the [[Original Series]]' [[Spin Gear System]] Beyblade, [[Dranzer S]]. Due to the design of the system, the Blade is not customizable and is a single piece that cannot be separated. As such, its main contact points are two long blades that enable [[Upper Attack]], based on those of the Double Wing Attack Ring. Parts resembling the Eight Balance Weight Disk act as additional contact points. The Gear Chip features the Dranzer Bit Beast, based on the original Bit Chip design. Like other X-Over Project Blades, '''DranzerSpiral''' has polycarbonate plastic Launcher Hooks instead of metal ones. '''DranzerSpiral''' is the lightest Blade released at 27.7 grams, weighing 4 to 7 grams less than the other Blades released on the same date. The light weight allows a '''DranzerSpiral''' to move at high speeds when used with a flat tip Bit such as [[Bit - Flat|Flat]] and [[Bit - Rush|Rush]]. However, the light weight also creates very low Stamina, and less [[Smash Attack]] than other Attack Type Blades such as [[Blade - SharkEdge|SharkEdge]]. ==Overall== Despite its high speeds, the light weight of '''DranzerSpiral''' makes it outclassed by other Attack Type Blades. Furthermore, it is too light to be used in Defense and Stamina combinations. '''As such, DranzerSpiral is not recommended for the WBO's X format.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-00 [[DranzerSpiral 3-80T]] * BX-00 [[DranzerSpiral 3-80T]] (Black Ver.) G1752 (Hasbro) |Classification=Blade |Type=Balance |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=33.0 grams |System=Unique Line |Series=Beyblade X |ReleaseJP=March 30th, 2024 |ReleaseUS=March 7th, 2025 |ReleaseCA=March 13th, 2025 |ReleaseEU=February 2025 |AttackStat=50 |DefenseStat=25 |StaminaStat=25 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''HellsHammer'''|ヘルズハンマー|Heruzu Hanmā}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Unique Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the UX-02 Starter, [[HellsHammer 3-70H]], on March 30th, 2024. It later debuted in western countries as '''Hammer Incendio''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Hammer Incendio 3-70H]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Its thick Smash Blades specialize in blasting opponents into the Stadium floor. |speaker = Official Description}} '''HellsHammer''' is a right-spin Balance Type Blade with three "Smash Blades" acting as the main contact points. The Gear Chip features a flaming skull representing the [[wikipedia:Death (personification)|Grim Reaper]]. Despite its Balance Type classification by Takara Tomy, '''HellsHammer''' has a very aggressive Attack Type Blade design. As part of the ''[[Unique Line]]'', '''HellsHammer''' has resin Launcher Hooks instead of metal ones, which increase Outward Weight Distribution (OWD). In addition, it features an Unique Line gimmick: the three-sided shape and aggressive design of the "Smash Blades" create high amounts of [[Smash Attack]] and [[Force Smash]] (downward Smash Attack). '''HellsHammer''' is intended to be used in tandem with the [[Bit - Hexa|Hexa]] Bit. The Hexa Bit increases the frequency of Force Smash by uprighting a '''HellsHammer''' combination and then tilting it downward. Consequently, a '''HellsHammer''' combination "smashes down repeatedly like a hammer", hence the Blade's name. Its initial mold could unintentionally be launched in left-spin. Subsequent releases by Takara Tomy and Hasbro have a modified mold that adds extra metal to prevent this, slightly increasing the Blade's weight by half a gram. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== *CX-17 [[Random Booster Vol. 10]] - 04: [[HellsHammer 3-85GU]] *UX-02 [[HellsHammer 3-70H]] *UX-10 [[Customize Set U]] (Metal Coat: Blue) *UX-00 [[Bey Kick Off Set]] - [[HellsHammer 3-70H]] (Metal Coat: Red FC Barcelona Ver.) ===Hasbro=== *G1752 [[Hammer Incendio 3-70H]] *G3195 [[X-treme Expansion Pack]] (Metal Coat: Blue) ==Gallery== BladeHellsHammer.png|HellsHammer (UX-02/G1752) HellsHammer (Metal Coat Blue).png|HellsHammer (Metal Coat: Blue; UX-10/G3195) HellsHammer 3-85GU.png|HellsHammer (CX-17) HellsHammer 3-70H (Metal Coat Red FC Barcelona Ver.).png|HellsHammer (Metal Coat: Red FC Barcelona Ver.) ==Trivia== *Despite its Balance Type labeling, '''HellsHammer''' has Attack Type stats. **Hasbro's G1752 Starter Pack release erroneously labels '''HellsHammer''' as an Attack Type Blade. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Unique Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]] [[Category:Parts with multiple molds]]

It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-02 Starter, [[HellsScythe 4-60T]], on June 10th, 2023. It later debuted in western countries as '''Scythe Incendio''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Scythe Incendio 4-60T]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Excels at taking on many different opponents with its four smashing blades. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Scythe Incendio''' (Japanese: '''HellsScythe''') is a round four-sided Balance Type Blade with four blades acting as the main contact points. The Gear Chip features a flaming skull representing the [[wikipedia:Death (personification)|Grim Reaper]]. The round shape creates excellent Stamina and '''HellsScythe''' is among the heaviest non-Attack Type Blades released. Its high Stamina and heavy weight has made it a popular choice in Stamina combinations, often paired with the [[Bit - Ball|Ball (B)]] Bit. The high performance and relatively low [[wiktionary:skill floor|skill floor]] of '''HellsScythe''' Stamina combinations has led to frequent top placements in tournaments since its release. While '''HellsScythe''' has excellent raw Stamina, it suffers from high recoil due to the gaps in its four blades. As such, '''HellsScythe''' has low Knockout (KO) Defense, although this recoil can also knock back Attackers into the Over or Xtreme Zones. '''HellsScythe''' also has a small amount of [[Smash Attack]], which allows it to be used in [[Anti-Attack]] Balance combinations. Releases of '''HellsScythe''' produced during June 2025 onward have a new reinforced mold with four square plastic tabs on the underside of the Blade. The addition of these tabs reduces the imbalance of the Blade, making it more stable. The tabs also increase the overall Blade weight by about 1 gram. ==Overall== Although a top-tier Stamina Blade at the beginning of the toyline, and for many months afterward, '''HellsScythe''' has since been outclassed by the likes of WizardRod and SilverWolf. '''As such, HellsScythe is not recommended for the WBO's X format.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-02 [[HellsScythe 4-60T]] (red) * BX-08 [[3on3 Deck Set]] - [[HellsScythe 3-80B]] (yellow) * BX-14 [[Random Booster Vol. 1]] - 05: [[HellsScythe 4-80LF]] (green) * BX-48 [[Random Booster Vol. 9]] - 04: [[HellsScythe 3-85GB]] (Metal Coat: Gold Minor Change Version) (gold) * BX-00 [[HellsScythe 4-60T]] (Metal Coat: Gold) (gold) * BX-00 [[HellsScythe 3-80F]] (SP X Bey) (blue) ===Hasbro=== * F9583 [[Scythe Incendio 4-60T]] * G0285 [[Scythe Incendio 3-80B]] ==Gallery== BladeHellsScythe.png|HellsScythe (BX-02; Official Image) HellsScythe (BX-08).png|HellsScythe (BX-08) HellsScythe 4-80LF.png|HellsScythe (BX-14) HellsScythe 4-60T (Metal Coat Gold).jpg|HellsScythe (Metal Coat: Gold) HellsScythe 3-80F.jpg|HellsScythe (BX-00) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Basic Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]] [[Category:Parts with multiple molds]]

parts.title: Blade - ImpactDrake
parts.text:
{{Part Infobox |Image=BladeImpactDrake.png |Name=ImpactDrake |JPName=インパクトドレイク |RomajiName=InpakutoDoreiku |ProductCode=UX-11 (Takara Tomy)
G0842 (Hasbro) |Classification=Blade |Type=Attack |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=39.0 grams |System=Unique Line |Series=Beyblade X |ReleaseJP=December 28th, 2024 |ReleaseUS=May 2025 |ReleaseCA=May 2025 |ReleaseAU=May 2025 |AttackStat=75 |DefenseStat=25 |StaminaStat=10 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''ImpactDrake'''|インパクトドレイク|InpakutoDoreiku}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Unique Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the UX-11 Starter, [[ImpactDrake 9-60LR]], on December 28th, 2024. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Drop Attack Battle Set]]. ==Description== '''ImpactDrake''' is an Attack Type Blade with four blades acting as the main contact points. The Gear Chip features the side profile of the [[wikipedia:Azure Dragon|Blue Dragon (Seiryū)]], one of the [[wikipedia:Four Symbols|Four Auspicious Beasts]] from Chinese mythology. Like the other Team Pendragon Beyblades, the Gear Chip has the ''Bakuten Shoot Beyblade'' logo, in this case being on the dragon's neck. As part of the ''[[Unique Line]]'', '''ImpactDrake''' has rubber Launcher Hooks instead of metal ones, which increase Outward Weight Distribution (OWD). In addition, it features an Unique Line gimmick: each of the four blades have rubber dragon heads. The 4 primary contact points are located where the end of the rubber dragon heads meet the metal portion of the blades. At the time of its release, '''ImpactDrake''' was the heaviest Blade available, weighing 39 grams on average. The aggressive shape of the jagged contact points creates extremely high Burst Attack and Knockout (KO) Attack. However, these contact points will wear down with use, with the metal denting in a manner similar to the wear issues of the [[Blade - DranSword|DranSword]] Blade. The rubber dragon heads will also dent and chip, increasing contact with the metal portion of the blades. It is thus recommended to have several copies of '''ImpactDrake''' for competitive usage. ==Overall== '''ImpactDrake''''s heavy weight and excellent Burst/Smash Attack makes it one of the strongest Attack Type Blades, in terms of raw attacking strength. '''As such, ImpactDrake is a must-have for the WBO's X format.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-50 [[Random Booster Vol. 11]] - 03: [[ImpactDrake 7-55FB]] * UX-11 [[ImpactDrake 9-60LR]] ===Hasbro=== * G0842 [[Drop Attack Battle Set]] - [[Impact Drake 9-60LR]] ==Gallery== BladeImpactDrake.png|ImpactDrake (UX-11) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Unique Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-04 Starter, [[KnightShield 3-80N]], on July 15th, 2023. It later debuted in western countries as '''Helm Knight''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Helm Knight 3-80N]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Its six defensive blades create an impact dampening structure, easily absorbing attacks. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Helm Knight''' (Japanese: '''KnightShield''') is a round Defense Type Blade with six main contact points. The Gear Chip features a [[wikipedia:Knight|knight]] wearing a [[wikipedia:Close helmet|close helm]]. '''KnightShield''' was one of the first four Blades released, and was the first Defense Type Blade released. The original weight of '''KnightShield''' averaged 32.4 grams, slightly less than its contemporary, HellsScythe (Scythe Incendio), which averaged 33.0 grams. '''KnightShield''' was popular in [[3on3 Battle]] decks and was common in decks from its release in June 2023 until March 2024, when it was immediately outclassed by the heavier [[Blade - WizardRod|WizardRod (Wand Wizard)]] Blade. WizardRod, which had a similar shape and use, eventually replaced both '''KnightShield''' and HellsScythe for Defense and Stamina combos. Releases of '''KnightShield''' produced during January 2025 onward (which all have a clear coat) have a new reinforced mold that weighs 34.8 grams on average. This second mold was first released with Takara Tomy and Hasbro reprints of the original BX-04/F9581 [[KnightShield 3-80N]]. '''KnightShield''' is the base design for several retools: [[Blade - Iron Man|Iron Man]], [[Blade - Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]], [[Blade - Optimus Prime|Optimus Prime]], and [[Blade - Bumblebee|Bumblebee]]. The retools weigh less than '''KnightShield''', and have worse balancing and contact points. ==Overall== Although a competitive release at the beginning of the toyline, '''KnightShield''' has subsequently been replaced by heavier Defense and Stamina Type Blades.
